# Evidence-Backed Talent Proof Portal

Capability ID: talent-proof-portal-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/talent-proof-portal-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

## Use this when

- help me hire based on skills
- verify candidate ability
- talent evidence portal
- skills based hiring
- prove candidate competency
- find talent by demonstrated ability

## Problem

Talent discovery relies heavily on resumes and claims that poorly connect demonstrated capability to opportunities.

## Inputs

Authorized candidate/profile evidence, competency model, target role/opportunity and organization privacy requirements.

## Outputs

Evidence-backed profiles, competency proof, opportunity routing and outcomes tracking.

## Pricing

Current organization hypothesis $500-$3,000/month; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; privacy/onboarding acceptance work pending.

No employment decision is automated by discovery. Participant consent/authority and payment are required where applicable.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
